author: Animalogic
description:
What creatures lurk in the darkest parts of the ocean? How did giant predators like mosasaurs and sperm whales dominate the seas, and why have some of the strangest marine animals evolved to such enormous sizes? From ancient sea monsters to bizarre deep-sea fish, these creatures reveal just how wild life beneath the waves can be.

00:05 - The Sea Monster With a Buzzsaw for a Mouth
25:00 - Giant Squid: The Origin of the Kraken
30:23 - Mosasaurus: The 50-Foot Lizard That Ruled the Ocean
37:53 - Why Is The Deep Sea Full of Giants?
50:11 - Helicoprion: The Buzz Saw Shark
57:11 - Dunkleosteus: The Armoured Mega Fish That Terrorized The Devonian Sea
1:05:22 - The Black Sea Devil: The Creepiest Fish in The Ocean
1:21:29 - Sperm Whales
